service.description: A recruiter's openings (PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW) of the employers in scope (one asked for, ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside): by state (draft and open unless asked), a title search ignoring case, or one by id; each with its employer, owner, seats, dates, state (an open one past its closing is shown closed), mail intake tag, scorecard, open and all applications, whether the caller changes it and its revision. Paged, an export up to the cap.

actions.script: for (const key of ['', 'Count', 'PageIndex', 'PageSize', 'PageMaxIndex', 'PageRangeLow', 'PageRangeHigh']) context['openings' + key] = found['openings' + key]

service.description: A new opening (a draft, or open with action open) of an employer in the recruiter's scope, or a change of one at the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED); action open, close or reopen. PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW and PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT. Its seats (emplPositionIds) are approved active positions of the employer (POSITION_REQUIRED, POSITION_UNAVAILABLE, POSITION_NOT_APPROVED), checked again when it opens; the owner works for the employer (OWNER_INVALID); the plus tag is unique among draft and open openings (TAG_INVALID, TAG_TAKEN); the scorecard a published interview scorecard of the employer (FORM_UNAVAILABLE); the closing after the opening (DATES_INVALID). Close keeps the applications.

A recruiter's applications (PERMISSION_DENIED without PEOPLE_RECRUIT_VIEW) of the employers in scope: of an opening (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside), by stage (the open stages unless asked), an applicant name search ignoring case; each with the applicant, opening, stage, owner, applied date, next interview, source, a possible duplicate, whether the caller changes and moves it, and its revision; stages: the board's columns with their counts. Paged. Panel members read their applications through get#Application, never this list.

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: One stage, or a comma list

actions.script: for (const key of ['', 'Count', 'PageIndex', 'PageSize', 'PageMaxIndex', 'PageRangeLow', 'PageRangeHigh']) context['applications' + key] = found['applications' + key]

service.description: A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) records an application to an open opening of an employer in scope (OPENING_CLOSED for one that takes none): the applicant a person chosen (one related to the employer: an employee, an agent or an applicant to it; any other RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, as a missing one), else the person of the exact email given, else a new person (NAME_REQUIRED) with the email, with the Applicant role; the source and the referring employee (SOURCE_INVALID, REFERRER_INVALID), the contact permission and notes. Received; another open application of the person to the employer is flagged (duplicateOfApplicationId), never merged.

An application the caller reads (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): a recruiter of its employer reads everything (the applicant's email, source, referral, contact permission, notes, a possible duplicate, the files, every interview and every scorecard with its answers, which files are shared with the panel), a panel member of one of its interviews (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026) the applicant's name, the opening and its employer, the interviews they are on the panel of with their own scorecards only (myScorecards: to answer or answered) and the files shared with the panel (sharedFiles), never the stage, source, contact, notes, other files or interviews, nor another reviewer's scorecard. The scorecards are the application's record: the framework's get#FormResponse is never the way to read one.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) changes an application at the revision read: another open opening of the same employer (EMPLOYER_CHANGE, OPENING_CLOSED; a closed application keeps its opening), the source and referral, the contact permission and notes.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) moves applications (employmentApplicationIds, or one at its revision) to a stage, with the reason kept as the stage's audit change reason; each in its own transaction. A stage moves along its flow (STAGE_INVALID, SAME_STAGE; a hired, refused or withdrawn one APPLICATION_CLOSED); Interview needs a scheduled interview (INTERVIEW_REQUIRED), Offer an open offer (OFFER_REQUIRED; drafting one moves it, P17), and Hired is never a stage change (HIRED_BY_OFFER). Each refused or failed application is named in failures with its code; the rest go on.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) schedules an interview of an application before its offer (APPLICATION_CLOSED): a private event (WetEvent, WevRestricted) owned by the caller from startDate (DATE_PAST) for durationMinutes (10 to 480, DURATION_INVALID), at a location or, with videoCall, on a call link (org.moqui.call.CallServices.create#CallLink, in the event's location); the panel (panelPartyIds: employees of the employer with an account, PANEL_REQUIRED, PANEL_INVALID) and with inviteCandidate the applicant (CANDIDATE_NO_EMAIL) as attendees; each panel member assigned the scorecard (formId, else the opening's, else the employer's only published interview scorecard; SCORECARD_REQUIRED, FORM_UNAVAILABLE) with no link. A received or screening application moves to Interview. The invitations follow (mantle.work.EventServices.send#EventInvitations: users notified, the candidate emailed with the .ics); a failure to send is named (invitationsSent false) and the interview stays.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT of the employer; another's interview or a missing one is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) changes a scheduled interview: a new startDate (from now on, DATE_PAST), durationMinutes (10 to 480, DURATION_INVALID), location (not of a video interview, whose place is its call link, kept open until a day after the new end) or note; what is not given stays. A cancelled one is not changed (INTERVIEW_CANCELLED). The interview's event is People's (the EventManager PeopleInterview): this and cancel#Interview are where it changes, never Commons' EventDetail, the calendar or CalDAV (Commons calendar editors, Nov 12, 2026). The attendees whose invitation changed are told (send#EventInvitations); a failure to send is named (invitationsSent false) and the change stays.

A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT of the employer; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise) cancels a scheduled interview (INTERVIEW_CANCELLED when it already is): its event is cancelled, its scorecards stay as they are, and the attendees are told (send#EventInvitations: the cancel); a failure to send is named (invitationsSent false) and the cancel stays. reason is kept as the status change's reason.

A panel member answers the scorecard assigned to them (invitationId: another's or a missing one is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), once (ALREADY_ANSWERED), the values checked against the form as of now (its show and require rules and each value's type; FORM_VALUES_INVALID with the reasons) and kept as one FormResponse the invitation links; the response is never changed after (FormPublication.eecas.xml).

InterviewsCalendar's items from start to end (days, yyyy-MM-dd, or instants): the interviews the caller is on the panel of and, for a recruiter, those of the employers in scope, each "{applicant} · {opening}" (kind interview), never cancelled ones.

My interviews, a projected CalDAV collection (CalendarProjection PeopleMyInterviews): admitted for a user on an interview panel; the interviews they are on the panel of, "Interview · {opening}", never the candidate's name, another reviewer's scorecard or another opening's candidates.

Whether the caller reads an application's record, its notes and files (its content host, PE-01): a recruiter of its employer; canEdit for a recruiter with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT. A panel member reads none of it: they read the application through get#Application and get#MyInterview and the shared files through get#ApplicationFile. Never refuses: a missing application, or one not the caller's to read, answers recordVisible false, and so does a call with no user. get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles read it.

A private file of an application (its resume, a cover letter): the row, and the uploaded file saved through save#ApplicationContentFile. A resume (EactResume) is shared with the interview panel unless panelShared says N (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026); another file is not until a recruiter shares it (share#ApplicationContent). A recruiter of the employer with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT (check#ApplicationAccess: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside, PERMISSION_DENIED for a reader).
Internal to create#ApplicationContent, which checks the caller: the file of an application's content row.

return.message: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: File ${applicationContentId} is not of application ${employmentApplicationId}

actions.script: const fileStream = contentFile.getInputStream() try { docRr.putStream(fileStream) } finally { fileStream.close() }

service.description: The createApplication action of the mail client's rules (EmailRuleAction ErActCreateApplication, F65; run by org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.run#EmailRules with authorization off, so it checks itself what it does): a received message, once (a message already an application answers it), becomes a Received application to its opening (the one the action's value names, else the open opening whose plus tag a To or Cc address carries) when the opening takes applications and the rule may file into it: the opening's intake account is the message's, or the rule's owner is its recruiting owner now, with an enabled account, PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT and still working for the employer. The sender is the applicant (the person of the address, else a new person with the Applicant role), the subject the notes, the attachments the application's private files (the first its resume, shared with the interview panel, P17); a possible duplicate is flagged. Otherwise nothing is made and the reason is logged and answered.

parameter.name: value
parameter.description: The opening (jobOpeningId), or empty for the plus tag

service.description: A recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT of the employer) shares a file of an application with its interview panels (shared true), or stops sharing it; the change is audit-logged. RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a file not theirs to change, as a missing one. A panel member reads only the shared files (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026).

A file of an application to send: for a recruiter of its employer, or for a member of one of its interview panels when it is shared with the panel; its location, file name and whether it may show inline (a raster image or a PDF; anything else only downloads). RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as for a missing one.

The caller's own interviews (no party parameter; the user's call of Nov 12, 2026: a panel member answers from their self-service, People/SelfService and Commons/People/SelfService): those they are on the panel of, coming or of the last 30 days, and any older one whose scorecard is still to submit; each with when, the applicant's name, the opening, its employer and the scorecard's state (toAnswerCount: those to submit). Nothing else of the application.

One interview the caller is on the panel of (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): when and where (a video interview's call link), the note to the attendees, the panel, the applicant's name, the opening and its employer, the files a recruiter shared with the panel and the caller's own scorecard (its form to answer once with submit#Scorecard, or their answers). Never the application's stage, source, contact, notes or other files, nor another reviewer's scorecard.

The "Create application" create-from of a chat message (ironstone.comms.ChatServices.create#FromChat kind application): a recruiter (PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT) makes a Received application of the message's sender (never their own message: NOT_AN_APPLICANT) to the opening of the room's record (a JobOpening's room), else the open opening whose plus tag the message names (+tag), else the one open opening the caller owns (OPENING_REQUIRED), one the caller changes (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise) that takes applications (OPENING_CLOSED); the message's first line its notes, its files the application's private files (the first its resume, shared with the panel, P17). Once per message; a message of a room the caller does not read is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, one of an end-to-end encrypted room ROOM_ENCRYPTED.

The offers of the employers the caller reads offers of (a recruiter, HR or payroll reader in People's scope; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise): of one application (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside), of one employer (ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside), by state (statusId, a comma list; the open ones unless asked or an application is named); each with its terms by name, dates, state (an issued one past its expiry reads expired), what the caller may do and its revision; the pay terms only for a payroll reader (hasPayTerms for others). Newest first, paged.

actions.script: for (const key of ['', 'Count', 'PageIndex', 'PageSize', 'PageMaxIndex', 'PageRangeLow', 'PageRangeHigh']) context['offers' + key] = found['offers' + key]

service.description: An offer the caller reads (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as a missing one): a recruiter, HR or payroll reader of its employer, or an approver of the step waiting (who reads it without pay). Its terms by name, dates and note, state, the candidate's answer, the hire it made, its approval (the route, each step's approvers, the decisions; canDecide for the approver of the step waiting: names only), whether its letter is issued (letterRestricted when it holds pay the caller does not read), what the caller may do (canEdit, canEditPay, canSubmit, canIssue, canRespond, canWithdraw, canHire) and, for an HR editor of an accepted offer, hireTerms (what a hire from it starts with; never pay). Pay terms only for a payroll reader of the employer.

A new offer of an application at Interview or Offer (APPLICATION_STAGE; one open offer at a time, OFFER_OPEN), drafted by a recruiter with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT or an HR editor of its employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside), which moves the application to Offer; or a change of an offer's terms at the revision read (REVISION_CHANGED) while it is a draft, waiting or approved (OFFER_LOCKED): changed terms make a waiting or approved offer a draft again and supersede its approval. The terms: a seat of the opening (POSITION_REQUIRED, POSITION_NOT_OF_OPENING) checked as a hire checks it (POSITION_NOT_IN_EFFECT, POSITION_INACTIVE, POSITION_OCCUPIED), its department, a manager employed by the employer (MANAGER_NOT_EMPLOYED), a work location of the employer (FACILITY_OUTSIDE), a working schedule of the employer in effect then, the start (START_REQUIRED) before an optional end (DATES_INVALID), the expiry and a note (NO_EXPRESSIONS). Pay terms (payAmount, currencyUomId, timePeriodTypeId; an empty amount clears them) only with PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; PAY_INCOMPLETE, AMOUNT_INVALID, CURRENCY_PRECISION, CURRENCY_INVALID, FREQUENCY_INVALID). A term not given is kept.

An offer moved, under its lock (design §5 OfferDecision). submit: a draft asks for approval (a People approval of kind PakOffer, PeopleOfferApproval to the first step's approvers: the employer's HR officers unless a rule says otherwise; never who submitted it or the applicant; with none it waits), its terms checked again. approve and refuse (a reason): the step waiting, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the offer's revision (sourceRevision from a notice); the last approval approves it, a refusal makes it a draft again with the reason. withdraw: an open offer (its approval superseded). issue: an approved offer with an expiry to come (EXPIRY_REQUIRED, EXPIRY_PAST), its terms checked again; its letter is rendered and stored once (EmploymentLetter, never rendered again) and, once the issue commits, emailed to the applicant (send#OfferLetter, P17 review). accept and decline: the candidate's answer to an issued offer before its expiry (OFFER_EXPIRED), dated today or earlier (DATE_FUTURE), with a note and, for an acceptance, the signed letter (evidenceFile) kept. Each but approve and refuse needs PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT or PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED). An action already done answers as it is (repeated). Refuses ACTION_INVALID, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, REVISION_CHANGED, NOT_DRAFT, NOT_APPROVED, NOT_ISSUED, NOT_OPEN, the terms' refusals and record#Decision's (NOT_APPROVER, SELF_APPROVAL, ALREADY_DECIDED, SOURCE_CHANGED, REASON_REQUIRED, NOT_PENDING).

parameter.name: action
parameter.description: submit, approve, refuse, withdraw, issue, accept or decline

service.description: The PeopleOfferApproval topic's approve service, which approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user deciding the notice: change#OfferState approve at the offer and revision in the message (a notice of an earlier revision is refused); a notice of another record is SOURCE_INVALID.
The PeopleOfferApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason (the topic requires one): as approve#Offer, the offer a draft again with the reason.

The offer's letter for a reader of the offer (get#Offer's readers): once issued the stored letter (letter: its location, file name and type, who issued it and when; never rendered again), one holding pay terms only for a payroll reader of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED); before, the preview (letterHtml, People's letter template marked as a draft, with pay for a payroll reader alone).

The candidate's signed acceptance of an offer kept with it, for a reader of the offer: its location and file name (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise, as for none). The signed copy of a letter holding pay terms is read only with PAYROLL_VIEW, as the letter (PERMISSION_DENIED; P17 review).

The stored letter of an issued offer emailed to the applicant's address as an attachment, as it was stored (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026, P17 review): from the employer's address by the template PEOPLE_OFFER_LETTER, its message naming the position and the expiry, never pay. Run by the issue's tx-commit rule (PeopleRecruiting.secas.xml) as the issuer, who need not read the letter; or by a recruiter with PEOPLE_RECRUIT_EDIT or an HR editor of the employer again after a failure (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside; NOT_ISSUED). Once: a letter sent or waiting in the mail queue answers repeated. The outcome is recorded on the offer (letterSendStatus sent, queued or failed, the date, the address and why it failed: no address, no sender, a failed send) and never undoes the issue.
